invariants.rationale: The returned list is a result of collecting over streams, which never returns null.
data is streamed over and must not be null for the method's logic to execute without exception.
func is applied within a flatMap and must not be null to safely evaluate the stream pipeline.
parallelism is passed to indicate the parallel level; calling .parallel() typically only makes sense when positive.
result is explicitly collected as a List by toList().
